ideas.name: Refillable solid-cartridge deodorant system
ideas.concept: Metal/glass-free reusable twist case with paper-pouch refills of aluminium-free solid deodorant.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic deodorant sticks; case reuse with repeat refills.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: could not search. Prior knowledge: refill beauty growing in EU; deodorant refill space has several players.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own Scandinavian scent/formulation and case design; EU contract formulator exclusivity. Cosmetic (CPNP, no health claims).
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock or small CNC/silicone tooling; no steel moulds

ideas.name: Safety-razor refill blade club (design-led)

ideas.problem_solved: Disposable plastic razors and cartridge cost.
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: could not search; segment likely already crowded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design/brand, blade-sourcing exclusivity; weak copy resistance.
ideas.tooling_needed: Off-the-shelf blank with custom finish; no new mould
